description: Add, modify, and delete One Time Passwords in IPA.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Token hash algorithm. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created. Choices: "sha1" "sha256" "sha384" "sha512"

parameters.name: counter
parameters.description: Initial counter for the HOTP token. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the token (informational only).

parameters.name: digits
parameters.description: Number of digits each token code has. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created. Choices: 6 8

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Mark the token as enabled (default true). Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Length of TOTP token code validity in seconds. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Token model (informational only).

parameters.name: newuniqueid
parameters.description: If specified, the unique ID specified is changed to this.

parameters.name: notafter
parameters.description: Last date/time the token can be used. In the format YYYYMMddHHmmss. For example, 20200121182022 allows the token to be used until 21 January 2020 at 18:20:22.

parameters.name: notbefore
parameters.description: First date/time the token can be used. In the format YYYYMMddHHmmss. For example, 20180121182022 allows the token to be used starting on 21 January 2018 at 18:20:22.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: TOTP token / IPA server time difference. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created.

parameters.name: otptype
parameters.description: Type of OTP. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created. Choices: "totp" "hotp"

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Assigned user of the token.

parameters.name: secretkey
parameters.description: Token secret (Base64). If OTP is created and this is not specified, a random secret is generated by IPA. Note: Cannot be modified after OTP is created.

parameters.name: serial
parameters.description: Token serial (informational only).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to ensure. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: uniqueid
parameters.description: Unique ID of the token in IPA.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Token vendor name (informational only).

examples:
- name: Create a totp for pinky, allowing the IPA server to generate using defaults
  community.general.ipa_otptoken:
    uniqueid: Token123
    otptype: totp
    owner: pinky
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Create a 8 digit hotp for pinky with sha256 with specified validity times
  community.general.ipa_otptoken:
    uniqueid: Token123
    enabled: true
    otptype: hotp
    digits: 8
    secretkey: UMKSIER00zT2T2tWMUlTRmNlekRCbFQvWFBVZUh2dElHWGR6T3VUR3IzK2xjaFk9
    algorithm: sha256
    notbefore: 20180121182123
    notafter: 20220121182123
    owner: pinky
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Update Token123 to indicate a vendor, model, serial number (info only), and description
  community.general.ipa_otptoken:
    uniqueid: Token123
    vendor: Acme
    model: acme101
    serial: SerialNumber1
    description: Acme OTP device
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Disable Token123
  community.general.ipa_otptoken:
    uniqueid: Token123
    enabled: false
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Rename Token123 to TokenABC and enable it
  community.general.ipa_otptoken:
    uniqueid: Token123
    newuniqueid: TokenABC
    enabled: true
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

return_values.name: otptoken
return_values.description: OTP Token as returned by IPA API. Returned: always
